faq.title: Questions about web development in Lille

pourquoiLille.question: Why choose a web developer in Lille?
pourquoiLille.answer: Working with a local developer facilitates communication and allows for in-person meetings. Based in Lambersart, I know the local business landscape and can easily meet you in the Lille metropolitan area.

coutSite.question: How much does a website cost in Lille?
coutSite.answer: Rates vary depending on project complexity. A showcase website typically starts around €1,500, a web application from €3,000. Contact me for a free custom quote.

freelanceVsAgence.question: Freelancer or web agency: which to choose?
freelanceVsAgence.answer: A freelancer offers a single point of contact, more flexibility, and generally more competitive rates. An agency is better suited for very large projects requiring multiple specialists simultaneously.

delai.question: How long does it take to create a website?
delai.answer: Expect 1-2 weeks for a landing page, 2-4 weeks for a showcase website, and 1-3 months for a complex web application. I give you a precise estimate from our first conversation.

horsLille.question: Do you work with clients outside Lille?
horsLille.answer: Absolutely! While I prefer in-person meetings in the Lille metropolitan area, I also work via video calls with clients throughout France.

pourquoiNextjs.question: Why choose Next.js over React alone?
pourquoiNextjs.answer: Next.js adds server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and automatic optimizations to React. Result: faster sites that rank better on Google.

nextjsSeo.question: Is a Next.js site better for SEO?
nextjsSeo.answer: Yes, significantly. Unlike client-side React, Next.js generates complete HTML that Google can index immediately, improving your natural search ranking.

wordpressVsNextjs.question: What's the difference between a WordPress and Next.js site?
wordpressVsNextjs.answer: WordPress is ideal for content sites that need easy editing. Next.js offers superior performance and total flexibility for custom projects or web applications.

nextjsPME.question: Is Next.js suitable for small businesses?
nextjsPME.answer: Absolutely. Next.js allows creating ultra-fast showcase sites at controlled costs. Hosting is often free (Vercel) and performance is excellent.

prixReact.question: How much does a React/Next.js site cost?
prixReact.answer: Rates start around €2,000 for a Next.js showcase site and can go up to €10,000+ for a complex application. Free quote on request.

definition.question: What is a custom web application?
definition.answer: A custom web application is software accessible via browser, developed specifically to meet your company's needs: management, tracking, automation, etc.

siteVsApp.question: What's the difference between a website and a web application?
siteVsApp.answer: A website presents information (showcase). A web application allows interaction: creating accounts, managing data, performing actions. E.g.: a CRM, a dashboard.

coutApp.question: How much does web application development cost?
coutApp.answer: Budget starts around €3,000 for a simple application and can reach €15,000+ for complex projects with many features. Detailed quote on request.

delaiApp.question: How long to develop a web application?
delaiApp.answer: Expect 1 to 3 months depending on complexity. I work in agile methodology with regular deliveries so you can track progress and adjust as needed.

technologies.question: What technologies do you use?
technologies.answer: I develop with React/Next.js for frontend, Node.js for backend, and PostgreSQL or Supabase for databases. Modern, performant, and maintainable technologies.
